text:
Hannah: Quick thread — Meridian (partner) wants a co-sell POC embedding Redwood SDK into their agent. Asks: VPC vs private connector, KMS ownership, telemetry defaults, SSO type, and provisional pricing for a 6-week pilot. Anyone take?
Omar: I can own the arch + connector options. TL;DR: private connector inside their VPC preferred for data residency and easiest for SSO. VPC peering possible but slower to set up. SDK supports cache-first flows.
Priya: Security checklist: no shipped model weights, TLS1.3, option for mTLS, API keys via customer KMS supported (we need key policy details). Telemetry can be disabled; if enabled, it must exclude payloads. Ask them for a dataflow diagram and compliance docs (SOC2, DPA).
Leo: Pricing POV — for OEM/co-sell we usually do a short reserved node for predictability + a small per-miss surcharge. For a 6-week pilot propose: 3-week reserved credit + burst window + capped per-miss rate. Ill draft numbers.
Hannah: They want to anonymize emails before sending. Also asked if client can run a local LRU cache (LevelDB) to reduce egress.
Omar: Both OK. SDK should expose CacheAdapter; sample config below. Important: do NOT allow local model storage. For anonymization, recommend deterministic pseudonymization rather than raw hashing to preserve embedding signal. Run a small A/B eval.
Omar: Sample SDK config:
```json
{
  "endpoint": "https://private.meridian.redwood.example",
  "auth": "api_key",
  "cache": {"adapter": "leveldb", "ttl_seconds": 3600},
  "telemetry": {"enabled": false}
}
```
Priya: Questions to ask Meridian before we proceed: 1) Who owns the KMS (they or Redwood)? 2) Expected QPS and peak concurrency. 3) Will they provide anonymized eval dataset (200-500 rows). 4) IdP type (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM need.
Leo: Pricing draft action: I'll prepare two scenarios (reserved baseline vs burst-only) and include support SLAs for the pilot. Also include a capped spend option for the first 6 weeks.
Hannah: Actions: Omar  SDK + connector options doc; Priya  security questionnaire and list of blockers; Leo  provisional pricing scenarios; Ill schedule a 30m kickoff with Meridian.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Meridian co-sell embedded POC kickoff"   Wed 10:30 AM PT. Invite sent.
Omar: Ill open a repo branch with CacheAdapter stub and a minimal README before the call.
Priya: Sending questionnaire in DM. Please review before we share externally.
Leo: Adding telemetry opt-in language and pilot SLA to the quote. :thumbsup:
Hannah: Thanks team  please drop drafts into #partnerships/meridian and tag me.
